welcome.slide1_body: A cross-platform semantic file search and AI chat app. All your data stays on your device.
welcome.slide2_body: Not just file names — FileFinder understands file contents and finds what you need with natural language.
welcome.slide3_body: Add the folders you want to monitor and FileFinder will parse and index documents and images in the background.
welcome.slide4_body: Connect a local Ollama model or DeepSeek and let AI answer questions based on your own files.
welcome.slide5_body: The index, vectors and chat history are stored locally and never uploaded to any server.
welcome.model_download_prompt: Semantic search requires downloading an embedding model (about 2 GB). Download it now? You can also do it later in Settings — keyword-only search will be used until then.
